question: If the area of a sector of a circle is 462 cm² and the central angle is 120°, then its radius is ___.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A central angle of 120° means the sector is exactly 1/3 of a full circle.

Area of full circle = Area of sector × 3 = 462 × 3 = 1386 cm².

⇒ πr² = 1386

⇒ (22 ÷ 7) × r² = 1386

⇒ r² = 1386 × (7 ÷ 22) = 63 × 7 = 441

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of sector = 462 cm²

Central angle (θ) = 120°

**Formula Used:**

Area of a sector = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42cbf8419527abb2f451b35c95560e93f25ec3defdacab32a8a0eb5838f822a0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 462 = (120° ÷ 360°) × (22 ÷ 7) × r²

⇒ 462 = (1 ÷ 3) × (22 ÷ 7) × r²

⇒ r² = (462 × 3 × 7) ÷ 22

⇒ r² = 21 × 3 × 7

⇒ r² = 441

⇒ r = √441

⇒ r = 21

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Sector

The area of a sector of a circle with radius r and central angle θ (in degrees) represents a proportional slice of the entire circle's area. It is calculated using the formula: A = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr².

Length of an Arc

The arc length of a sector is a fraction of the circle's total circumference. It is calculated by multiplying the full circumference by the fraction of the angle: L = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr.

Perimeter of a Sector

The complete boundary or perimeter of a sector includes the curved arc length along with the two straight radii enclosing it. The formula is: Perimeter = L + 2r.
